summary: AI works with the newest models, and the earlier sign-in leaves nothing behind.

fixes.title: AI works with the newest models
fixes.text: The AI summary and the web chat ask the way current Azure OpenAI models expect, and adjust once by themselves.

fixes.title: The earlier sign-in leaves nothing behind
fixes.text: After the switch, the update removes the earlier sign-in's images and keys, each step read back.

fixes.title: Scripts are always published unsigned
fixes.text: A dormant signing path is removed, and a check keeps it out.
